notes: Much faster replies: DeepSeek's "thinking" step is now off (it spent a long time thinking first, and sometimes used up the whole reply on thinking so nothing came back). You can turn it back on in Settings.
The AI request is now arranged so DeepSeek can reuse most of it from turn to turn (prompt caching), which makes replies start sooner and cost less.
Replies never hang forever: if the AI doesn't answer within 2 minutes you get a clear message, and your message is kept.
While a reply is being written, the Send button becomes ■ Stop.
If a reply fails, ↻ Regenerate now retries it (it used to delete the previous reply instead).
Off-screen scenes and memories no longer slow down your own replies, and the story summary runs in the background.
